About the Clinic

Dental care that puts people first.

Jessique Dental Care is a modern, patient-centred dental clinic committed to providing high-quality dental treatment in a comfortable and welcoming environment. We believe that a healthy smile is the foundation of confidence and well-being.

Led by Dr. Rai Ragavi (BDS, MSc — Reg. No: 1205), our clinic combines clinical expertise with the latest dental technology to deliver care that is precise, gentle, and tailored to each patient's needs.

Dr. Rai Ragavi BDS MSc Reg. No: 1205 Painless Procedures Child & Senior Friendly

"Your Smile Our Priority"

What We Do

Our Treatments

From preventive care to advanced restorative work — all under one roof.

🦷

Root Canal Treatment

Painless, precision RCT using modern rotary techniques to save infected teeth. Fast recovery with minimal discomfort.

🔩

Dental Implants

Permanent titanium implants that replace missing teeth with natural-looking, fully functional results.

✨

Teeth Whitening

Professional in-clinic whitening for a noticeably brighter smile — safe, fast, and long-lasting results.

📐

Braces & Clear Aligners

Metal braces, ceramic braces, and clear aligners for all ages. Straighten your teeth comfortably and discreetly.

💎

Cosmetic Smile Correction

Crown, bridge, veneers, and full smile makeovers — designed to give you the confident smile you deserve.

🪥

Scaling, Fillings & More

Scaling & polishing, tooth extractions, fillings, dentures, children's dentistry, and geriatric dental care.

Why Choose Us

Dentistry done with care and respect.

  • 01

    Experienced, Qualified Dentist

    Dr. Rai Ragavi (BDS, MSc — Reg. No: 1205) brings a calm, methodical approach to every procedure — whether a simple cleaning or a complex smile correction.

  • 02

    Fully Sterilised, Modern Setup

    We follow strict infection-control protocols. All instruments are autoclave-sterilised; disposables are single-use. Your safety is non-negotiable.

  • 03

    Transparent Pricing

    We discuss treatment costs upfront, clearly. No hidden charges, no pressure — just honest advice about what you need and why.

  • 04

    Comfortable, Welcoming Environment

    Dental anxiety is real. Our clinic is designed to feel calm and approachable — we take the time to explain every step before we proceed.
